mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that dampens corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint growth in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5% and UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals persistent inflation that may prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% for 2 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate a tightening monetary policy amid rising inflation, which pressures corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a positive coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 100.5 for 3 consecutive months), a rebound in industrial production signals a recovery in supply chains, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rebounds from a slowdown, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
